# REMAINING WORK

## Completion state

All safe executable Olam H3 product work, mobile UI repair, premium visual polish, Director Console intelligence, automated verification, Git publication, canonical deployment, and public browser regression is complete.

Exactly one unresolved product node remains, externally blocked by the absent production MiniMax credential.

## Completed Director experience

- [x] Cinematic Director Console hero and animated viewfinder.
- [x] Live Shot Brief with Subject, Action, Camera, Light, Atmosphere, and Audio ingredient coverage.
- [x] Nonjudgmental coverage states from Blank canvas through Fully directed.
- [x] Live 0% to 100% prompt analysis without replacing the textarea or Shot Brief DOM nodes.
- [x] Neo-noir, Golden hour, Documentary, and Dreamlike macro style lanes.
- [x] Style directions append as editable prompt text and deduplicate repeated taps.
- [x] Reference recipes for character consistency, motion/camera, frame transitions, and voice/ambience.
- [x] Recipe cards switch into the correct H3 control mode.
- [x] Existing prompt templates, Paste Prompt, MiniMax onboarding, reference guidance, glass motion, and secure provider guard preserved.
- [x] Existing Estimated Cost / Generate / bottom-navigation no-overlap behavior preserved.

## Completed verification

- [x] Every Olam file remains <=120 lines.
- [x] JavaScript/test syntax checks passed.
- [x] Clean release-tree unit suite: 23 passed, 0 failed.
- [x] Director domain tests cover blank, partial, and fully directed prompts plus style deduplication.
- [x] Local Director browser proof: live 0% to 100%, all six ingredients, same DOM nodes, focus retention, style append, recipe mode switch, animated viewfinder, no overflow, no browser/network errors.
- [x] Separate local premium/mobile/security regression passed unchanged.
- [x] Public Director browser job completed exit 0 against `https://awtsmoos.com`.
- [x] Separate public premium/mobile/security regression completed in the same guarded job with exit 0.

## Current release lineage

- [x] Initial release `8c30101ece9f88af6fe3e2b32f44ff1fbef7b0ad`.
- [x] Provider readiness `8499a37d3e3b1bf5419749cf24cdf69dc2726dbe`.

- [x] Director Console release `df2b30c338582fda21d533c2f500bb248133cdb2`.
- [x] Director release was based on newer remote parent `569f142f45fe72f83e85b22ffda089e429de4e79` after proving concurrent remote work changed zero Olam files.
- [x] Director push was a normal fast-forward; no force push.
- [x] Canonical deploy emitted `CANONICAL_SERVER_ACTIVE` and `CANONICAL_DEPLOY_OK` for the Director SHA.

## External blocker

- [ ] Configure `MINIMAX_API_KEY` in the production `awtsmoos.service` environment.

The production server previously reported `configured: false`. Olam intentionally never accepts or stores the secret in browser UI. The key cannot be safely fabricated, inferred, or recovered from repository state.

## NEXT_ACTION after credential configuration

1. Canonically restart or redeploy the service.
2. Verify `/api/olam-h3/status` reports `configured: true` without exposing the key.
3. Run one minimum 4-second 768P real H3 generation.
4. Verify task ID, polling, `task.content.url`, playback, persistence, and local cache.
5. Run one small image-reference generation.
6. Record the paid-generation evidence and close the external blocker.

## Hard-stop justification

No safe project action can manufacture the missing third-party production credential. Every known work item not requiring that credential—including the requested deeper UI/UX improvement—is implemented, tested, pushed, deployed, and publicly verified.
